source: Written for quran/y6 lesson 38 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Infitar 82:17-19 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 38. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ (١٧) ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ (١٨) يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ (١٩)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Idgham without ghunnah: tanween into ل
Ikhfa': tanween before ش; then the sign ۖ

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Infitar 82:17-19 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 82:17-19 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 82:17-19 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Recite all of Al-Infitar to a partner.
82:17 and 82:18 repeat a question. Why might the Qur'an repeat it?
questions.a: To show how great and serious the Day of Judgement is.

questions.q: On that Day no soul can ...
questions.a: A) do anything for another soul. 82:19: 'The Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing.'

questions.q: Al-Infitar 82:19: «يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: 'The command, that Day, is entirely with Allah' (82:19). How does this help a person who feels nobody will be fair to them?
questions.a: Allah will judge with complete justice; no one can be wronged on that Day.
